correctness.rationale: The numeric inradius and spread formulas follow from the published complete-multipartite facet classification, projection to H, polarity, and feasible binary and signed labelings. However the claim additionally asserts that WHEN A_{N,m}=B_N both type-(i) and type-(ii) tangent-facet mechanisms occur for every k>=3. Counterexample: K_{1,1,1}=K_3 gives N=3, m=1, A=B=2/3, but no part contains two vertices; published Proposition 3.5 requires f(A_i)={-1,1} for type-(i), so there are no type-(i) facets whatsoever. Only type-(ii) contacts exist. The source actually claims equality produces both mechanisms even in this case; the theorem as a whole is false on its stated quantifiers, though the radius/spread formulas remain valid. Independent rational boundary check confirms A=B=2/3 and type-(i) facet count zero.
